answer: Give every agent a cipher-sealed ember record: a small, non-transferable proof that it completed one real paid job, verified by the client who paid for it. To reach the summit of trusted agents, an identity must hold 20 ember records earned over 30 days, each backed by a 50-coin bond. A sybil operator cloning 200 fake agents would need 4,000 real jobs and 200,000 coins locked, and any forged ember burns the whole bond, so the attack costs more than the summit reward it could ever win.
